judge.rationale: The production code change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` is identical to the reference, moving `await hooks.beforeSession(session)` inside the `try` block. The candidate satisfies all acceptance criteria, including documenting the guarantee and partial-session assumptions in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`. Instead of adding the new test case directly into `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` (and updating spec line numbers across the repository) as the reference did, the candidate created two separate new test files (`chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts`), likely due to a literal reading of 'existing tests remaining unedited'. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate also unnecessarily changed the spec's status from `Shipped` to `In Progress` and renamed the `Measured semantics — out of scope` heading instead of placing the new guarantee in the main list.
